newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian Rosenbauer reports H1 net loss.
newsitem.headline: Austrian Rosenbauer reports H1 net loss.

text.p: Rosenbauer International AG, the Austrian manufacturer of fire appliances, on Wednesday reported a first half group net loss of eight million schillings compared with breakeven the previous year.
It said government budget cuts had increased the firm's tax burden, mainly by reducing tax breaks for exports.
Rosenbauer said it was undertaking a stringent cost-cutting programme and attempting to boost production abroad, particularly in the U.S.
Group pre-tax profit jumped 50 percent to 12 million schillings. Rosenbauer forecast full-year pre-tax earnings would exceed the 65.5 million posted in 1995.
"The half year in the fire appliances business is not representative for the full year because the bulk of earnings come in the second half," Rosenbauer said.
First half group sales rose to 898 million schillings from 702 schillings. Rosenbauer forecast 1996 group turnover of around two billion schillings, almost level with 1995.
